title: Joe Gabriel playing at his grocery
summary: Playing violin and rhythm with Joe Gabriel at his grocery.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Fiddlers and reading violinists of New Orleans

blocks.x: And Joe Gabriel was out there too huh?
I played with Joe Gabriel after he retired in his grocery. They called him Papi for nickname.
Papi. I wanted to see him but you know he fainted. Punch and I went up that once.
Did you get a chance to see him?
No. I think Punch was with me, I can't remember.
He had a small grocery store on Narrow Street.
Well he gets excited when, you know he was sick and he gets excited when people came in.
Yeah, he was living with his sister.
Yeah and I had a message from Punch, I think that was it. I'd written up that. You know, because Punch wanted me to say hello to him. But you went in the grocery store and played with him.

In his house, back in the house. Yeah. Oh yeah in the grocery store and played with him. See he used to get his violin and me and him used to sit down and drink wine together and you know, serenade on things like 12th Street Rag you know, or some old number that you know, in the background like that.
But he, would you call him a jazz musician or a rhythm musician? How would you say that?
Well he was a, I never, he was a rhythm musician because he, there wasn't too many numbers he could think.
